Top row THREE different individuals in ONE trio; bottom row THREE DIFFERENT individuals in a SECOND trio. THIS IS NOT A TIER/CAREER/EMOTION progression. Never repeat one identity across row. Three means a crowd: each row belongs together by restrained costume/material motif and complementary personality, but each actor must function independently outside group. No handoffs, pointing at neighbour, overlaps or shared objects.
Reference image1 ORIGINAL freche-family for whole dark INK morphology/material; image2 ORIGINAL props reference for modeling craft only. STYLE REFERENCES, NOT edit targets or character templates. No likenesses of actors/musicians, no film still reconstruction, all are ORIGINAL grotesque ink blobs.

Hands are goo continuous with body. No humanoid torso/legs/feet/busts, no whole coats/robes hiding goo. Dark ink face/body dominant, accessories small and readable. Every OPEN eye has WHITE/ivory sclera surrounding separate RED iris and BLACK pupil. Planned cyclops has same colour rule. No all-red/glowing eyeballs. Offbeat absurd/surreal satirical peak acting, not generic cute Pixar babies, no repeated V-brow tooth grin. Differentiate body contour, eye/lid shapes, mouth, posture and temperament BEFORE props. Some mouths closed, some open, unequal gazes; NO protruding tongue in ANY cell.

Centres(256,256),(768,256),(1280,256),(256,768),(768,768),(1280,768). Never cross x512,x1024,y512. Similar overall body size, no giant boss. Few bold simple functional handmade props, rich softly rounded wood/metal/cloth, not machinery clutter. Entire figure isolated, no floor/cast shadows/scenelet/scenery/extra heads.

SHARED restrained belonging cue: tiny black/ivory STRIPED cloth collars and little soft striped caps, ONE dull-red square patch each, exposed dark goo bodies.

Unequal wide WHITE/red/black eyes DOWN, worried crooked CLOSED lower lip. Hugs ONE rolled blank cream escape sketch with ONE short fat red carpenter pencil tucked in fold.
MIDDLE: A DIFFERENT FEMALE-READ determined prison tunnel specialist. SHORT very WIDE blunt-lobed ink splat, TWO low crown nubs, subtle lashes, THREE widely spaced upper teeth. One eye squints shut with effort, other forward, side-clenched tooth grimace. Grips ONE absurdly broad bent steel SOUP SPOON against own belly like her entire practical education.
RIGHT: A DIFFERENT male nervous prison baggage keeper. ROUND upright dumpling ink blob, crown forms THREE tiny offset drops, TWO big lower teeth, heavy trembling lip. White/red/black eyes stare SIDEWAYS, pinched worried half-open underbite. Both goo hands protect ONE tiny patched brown drawstring BUNDLE with a little blank ivory tag, no loot spilling.

BOTTOM ROW TRIO: Der ordentliche Einbruch. Context: Original heist crew. SHARED restrained belonging cue: little BURGUNDY knit caps with a TEAL stitched patch and short cream neckerchiefs, no suits covering bodies.
LEFT: A DIFFERENT male punctilious lock specialist. MEDIUM narrow upright pear ink blob, stiff sideways crown curl, thick upper lip and ONE crooked upper tooth. Half-lidded judgmental side-eye, CLOSED pursed lip. Holds ONE enormous old brass KEY and ONE short fat blunt lock pick together low at belly, simple readable tools.
MIDDLE: A DIFFERENT FEMALE-READ over-alert lookout. TALL leaning inverted-drop ink splat, TWO antenna-like rounded crown lobes, subtle lashes, asymmetrical upper fangs. One eye CLOSED and one WHITE/red/black very wide looking outward, crooked small tense mouth. Hugs ONE stubby thick battered BRASS SPYGLASS at her own belly, not looking through it or pointing at another actor.
RIGHT: A DIFFERENT male unhurried getaway driver. WIDE low upright bean splat with a huge coiled crown loop, ONE square lower tooth, sleepy drooping lids. Exhausted unimpressed WHITE/red/black gaze and enormous CLOSED pout. Holds ONE small three-spoke BLACK rubber steering wheel with iron hub, loose in both goo hands, no car.
EMPTY BACKGROUND AND HOLES ACTUAL ALPHA0, interiors opaque with soft antialiased outer edge only. No gradient/matte/checkerboard/floor/shadowdiscs, no lettering/numbers/logos/labels/borders or floating punctuation. Six complete distinct characters, two coherent TRIOS, exactly TWO female-read figures in sheet. Body/face individuality first; group relationship second; simple iconic props third.
